Implemented the contact form in [ContactForm.tsx](/workspace/app/ContactForm.tsx). It has labeled name, email, and message fields, browser `required` constraints, and an inline server action that checks each value is a nonempty string before accepting the submission.

There’s no contact storage service in the app yet, so valid submissions are logged on the server. I didn’t run tests.
